datasets.name: ODSBoorInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum,creditid, name, age, birthdate, address, worknpost, to_number(moneymoney) moneymoney,
       credamtgiven, credamtym, credperiodcred, credperiodym,
       credperccred, credpercym
  FROM cm_ip_boorowerinfo

datasets.name: ODFReserves
datasets.sql: select id,code,percent,description, percent||'% - '||description fulldesc from cm_reserves

datasets.name: ODSMKTsInfo
datasets.sql:
select ROWNUM, a.*
  from (select   mktname,bank_kod1, sum (1) boorcnt, sum (givencount)/1000 givencount,
                 sum (givenamount)/1000 givenamount,sum (ymamount)/1000 ymamount, 
                 sum (REST)/1000 REST,
                 sum (CLOSECRDCOUNT) CLOSECRDCOUNT,
                 sum(CLOSECRDYMAMOUNT)/1000 CLOSECRDYMAMOUNT,sum(fakcredcount) as fakcredcount,
                 sum(fakymkrcount) as fakymkrcount, sum(fakymkrrest)/1000as fakymkrrest
            from cm_ip_mktsinfo
        group by mktname,bank_kod1 order by bank_kod1) a

datasets.name: ODSMKTInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum, creditid, aktno, boorower, credamountgiven, credamountym,
       credamountpayed, credamountrest, percentagemkt, percentageaif,
       periodcredit, periodym, anuitet, contractdate, contractno,
       ipcontractdate, ipcontractno, mktname, tickno
  FROM cm_ip_mktinfo
 order by mktname

datasets.name: ODSInsurInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum, m.* FROM (select * 
  FROM cm_ip_insuranceinfo m






order by mktname
) m

datasets.name: ODSDateInfo

datasets.name: ODSPredInfo

datasets.name: ODSALEVInfo

datasets.name: ODSPschedInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.creditid, a.paymentdate, a.principal, a.restbefore, a.restafter, u.description mktname,
       b.name boorowername, p.numberofcredit crdnum, a.interest
  FROM cm_ip_pschedule a, cm_portfolio p, cm_usergroups u, cm_boorowerinfo b
 where a.creditid = p.id and p.usrgroup=u.id and p.id=b.creditid
order by a.creditid, a.paymentdate

datasets.name: MKT
datasets.sql:
select ROWNUM, a.*
  from (select   mktname,bank_kod2, sum (1) boorcnt, sum (givencount)/1000 givencount,
                 sum (givenamount)/1000 givenamount,sum (ymamount)/1000 ymamount, 
                 sum (REST)/1000 REST,
                 sum (CLOSECRDCOUNT) CLOSECRDCOUNT,
                 sum(CLOSECRDYMAMOUNT)/1000 CLOSECRDYMAMOUNT,sum(fakcredcount) as fakcredcount,
                 sum(fakymkrcount) as fakymkrcount, sum(fakymkrrest)/1000as fakymkrrest
            from cm_ip_mktsinfo where bank_kod2 is not null
        group by mktname,bank_kod2 order by bank_kod2) a
